title: Batch transcripts - one language delivered well below its own baseline

model.expr: (max by (route, language) (omi_batch_pipeline_delivered_share_ratio{language!="other",language!="unknown"}) < 0.7 * max by (route, language) (max_over_time(omi_batch_pipeline_delivered_share_ratio{language!="other",language!="unknown"}[7d]))) and on (route, language) (max by (route, language) (omi_batch_pipeline_delivered_share_admitted_units{language!="other",language!="unknown"}) >= 20)

annotations.summary: One batch route and language delivered transcripts well below its own trailing baseline.
annotations.user_impact: Owners speaking that language are missing transcripts while the fleet-wide delivery number stays near normal. The 2026-11-13 Japanese provider-STT miss went unseen for about a week for exactly this reason.
annotations.scope: Per route and language: the share of units admitted 20 to 5 minutes earlier that were published within the 5-minute target, compared with the same cell's 7-day peak, guarded by at least 20 admitted units in the 15-minute cohort.
annotations.verification: Read omi_batch_pipeline_delivered_share_ratio and omi_batch_pipeline_delivered_share_admitted_units for the route and language, then follow that language's units with the batch census (counts only, ro-prod). Compare the same window with scripts/batch_pipeline_delivered_share_report.py.
annotations.safe_next_action: Read the route and language from the firing labels; check that language's provider health, vendor_held reason and release state before redriving. Never set BATCH_PIPELINE_DELIVERED_SHARE_ENABLED=off to silence a real breach; the flag only stops the sample.
annotations.threshold: Share < 70% of the cell's 7-day peak, with at least 20 admitted units in the cohort, for 30m. Folded other/unknown cells cannot fire.
annotations.incident: 2026-11-13 Japanese provider-STT miss: transcripts did not reach users for about a week with no per-language signal. See backend/docs/runbooks/batch-language-delivery.md.
